subject.title: [Feature]: Support for Custom Emojis in Latest Telegram Bot API Update

question: What public representation should OpenClaw support for Telegram custom emoji in message-tool and reply payloads?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public tool/plugin API shape and Telegram rendering semantics across multiple delivery paths.

options.title: Add A Typed Telegram Entity Contract
options.body: Expose validated Telegram entity and caption-entity inputs through the message tool and plugin payloads, then wire them through all Telegram delivery paths with offset and fallback tests.

options.title: Add Shared Custom Emoji IR First
options.body: Model custom emoji in shared Markdown/rich-message IR before exposing Telegram-specific wire entities, accepting broader cross-channel design work.

options.title: Keep Raw HTML Only For Now
options.body: Treat the current `<tg-emoji>` allowlist as sufficient and close or narrow the entity-based request, accepting that plugin slash handlers still cannot send custom emoji entities.

recommendation.title: Add A Typed Telegram Entity Contract
recommendation.body: Expose validated Telegram entity and caption-entity inputs through the message tool and plugin payloads, then wire them through all Telegram delivery paths with offset and fallback tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the maintainer-review context for this issue and the adjacent parse-mode product decision.
